simple.meaning: שׁוֹבֵב (shôwbêb) is a Hebrew word meaning “apostate , i.e. heathenish or (actually) heathen.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: שׁוֹבֵב (H7728) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Jeremiah 31:22, with occurrences in Jeremiah, Micah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שׁוֹבֵב (H7728) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in שׁוֹבֵב (H7728) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: שׁוֹבֵב (shôwbêb) / H7728 is traced through Jeremiah 31:22, Jeremiah 49:4, Micah 2:4 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H7728. shobeb שׁוֺבֵב adjective backturning, apostate (perhaps for ׳מְשׁוֺ , see I. שׁוֺבָב ); — as substantive, ׳לְשׁו Micah 2:4 (but read probably שׁוֺבֵינוּ our captors ); feminine הַשּׁוֺבֵבָה הַבַּת Jer 31:22 (of Israel), 49:4 (of Ammon).

occurrences.englishText: How long will you go here and there,
